title: Your inventory system
for electonics.
hero.summary: Open-source, terminal based hardware inventory management system.

headingLines: Inventatory keeps track of your parts,
so you can focus on building.

steps.title: Receive parts
steps.text: Scan a supported vendor label to fill in component details, or import your order.
steps.mediaCaption: Stock workspace, part created from a label scan

media.alt: Stock workspace with a capacitor created from a DigiKey code scan, showing its parameters, rack location, and links.

steps.title: Put them away
steps.text: Inventatory assigns eligible parts to rack slots and can print their labels automatically.

steps.title: Build a board
steps.text: Import your KiCad BOM and see exactly which rack slots hold the parts you need.

steps.title: Undo anything
steps.text: Every inventory change is recorded. Name a checkpoint, reverse a mistake, restore a validated backup.

scanner.title: Inventatory Scan R1
scanner.summary: A custom, DiY-able hardware scanner that's directly integrated with Inventatory. It can read vendor labels, modify you stock and print labels for new parts automatically.

open.title: Build it yourself
open.text: The firmware, schematics and instructions that are needed to build the scanner are open-source and available for free. You can design and print your own enclosure.

bundle.title: Pre-designed CAD bundle
bundle.text: The 'just works' solution. It includes ready to use .STEP and .3MF files for the enclosure and charging dock for the scanner. Your purchase supports my projects, thank you!
